decisions.reason: The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core offer and still has no documented results beyond its premiere, but as a flagship of the firm's enhancement direction it is carried on slack while it builds a track record.
The sheet preparation module complements the modular lines at low cost of carrying, and no shortfall against aspirations is visible that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The B2 multifinisher is a core-adjacent flagship that matches the push toward automated finishing, so it is very likely to meet aspirations.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits established booklet-making demand and existing service capabilities, so there is little pressure to drop it.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation within the Touchline line, which shows results in line with aspirations.
